findings.claim: The architect prompt grants write ownership over all of docs/**, overlapping the domain/business documentation paths that other roles own.
findings.evidence: Acceptance criterion: "No two roles SHALL declare overlapping write paths in `owns`" and "Create owned documentation paths for business roles: `docs/integrations/`, `docs/sync/`, `docs/billing/`, `docs/compliance/`." The fhir-architect body says "Writable paths, and only these: `openspec/**`, `docs/**`, `DESIGN.md`...", while domain role headers own `docs/compliance/**`, `docs/integrations/**`, `docs/sync/**`, and `docs/billing/**`.
findings.suggested_fix: Make the architect prompt match its non-overlapping frontmatter ownership, e.g. `docs/*.md` and `docs/images/**`, or explicitly exclude the domain-owned subdirectories.
